description: S59 T6 (EV7): secretref.update moves the POINTER, never the value — here the reference is repointed from a daemon variable to a key file, and `injectAs` is untouched because its field is absent (a nil *string means "leave alone", which is the three-state answer for a partial edit). The name is the key: it is what every environment's spec refers to, so the environments keep working while the source moves underneath them.

params.name: deploy-token
params.description: Moved off the daemon's environment onto a 0600 key file.
